languageTag.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation, set as the pages' lang attribute.

extensionDescription.message: Bilingual web page translation with the AI subscription you already have (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini).

toggleCommand.message: Turn translation on or off for this page

machineFallbackNote.message: Translating with the browser's built-in translator instead of the AI.

installHint.message: Run npm run install-host once in the repo folder. The chosen engine's CLI must be installed and signed in.
installHint.description: Keep "npm run install-host" as is; it is shown as code.

machineFallbackOption.message: Use the browser's built-in translator when the AI can't be reached

machineFallbackHint.message: The browser translates on your device (Google's model in Chrome, Microsoft's in Edge). The first time, click a failed translation once to download the language model.

versionMismatch.message: The bridge and the extension versions differ. Reload BYOS Translate in chrome://extensions or restart the browser. If you moved the repo folder or have more than one, run 'npm run install-host' again.

bridgeNotInstalled.message: The bridge is not installed. Run 'npm run install-host' in the repo folder.

extensionNotRegistered.message: This extension is not registered with the bridge. Run 'npm run install-host' again.

bridgeUnreachable.message: Couldn't talk to the bridge ($DETAIL$). Check native-host.log in the data folder.

segmentsUnanswered.message: The model didn't answer some paragraphs.

providerNotFound.message: $PROVIDER$ was not found. Install it, sign in, then restart the browser.

modelNeeded.message: ⚠ The browser's translation model is needed · Click to download (first time only)

machinePairUnsupported.message: The browser's built-in translator doesn't support $SOURCE$ → $TARGET$.

noMachineTranslator.message: This browser has no built-in translator (Chrome 138 or later, or a recent Edge, is needed).

translationFailed.message: ⚠ Translation failed · Click to try again
